offers_products.reason: Sells software licences and SaaS: Telerik/Kendo UI, MarkLogic, Sitefinity, Chef, Semaphore, OpenEdge, WhatsUp Gold, Kemp load balancers.

offers_services.reason: Revenue is overwhelmingly software; professional services and support are secondary to the software products.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Sells developer tools, data platforms and infrastructure software to businesses and government, not households.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Customers are enterprises, developers, ISVs and federal government, defense and public sector agencies.

recurring_revenue.reason: Subscriptions, maintenance and renewals on software like OpenEdge, Chef, MarkLogic and Sitefinity drive most revenue.

cyclical_demand.reason: Mission-critical infrastructure and application software under renewing subscriptions; customers rarely cut it in downturns.

big_ticket.reason: Mostly subscriptions and renewals for developer tools and infrastructure software; individually modest, recurring purchases.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for software technology such as Telerik, MarkLogic and Chef, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Cites Fortune 500 usage and federal government, defense and public sector customers; enterprise software focus.

asset_heavy.reason: Software development and cloud delivery business needs no heavy plants, fleets or properties.
